stages.name: The Gatepass
stages.tagline: Rotters climb the gate road while carrion bats circle overhead.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 75%

stages.name: Cinder Steps
stages.tagline: Bone soldiers march down the cinder stairs.

stages.name: Lantern Hollow
stages.tagline: Runners and shriekers pour out of the old lantern mine.

stages.name: Deepvein Shafts
stages.tagline: Dead miners tunnel beneath the line. Loose rock falls from the shaft roof.

stages.name: Bonefield Ridge
stages.tagline: A wall of coffin-lid shields screens archers on the ridge.

challenge.text: Win with at most 5 unit types deployed

stages.name: Hollowbell Chapel
stages.tagline: The chapel bell is silent; its priests now raise the fallen.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 70%

stages.name: Smelter's Rest
stages.tagline: Armored grave knights escort acid-spitting corpses through the old smelter.

stages.name: The Rotting Gate
stages.tagline: Something enormous is being stitched together beyond the gate.

stages.name: Skyhook Crag
stages.tagline: The crag's updrafts carry flocks of rotting wings. Gusts buffet aircraft.

stages.name: Maw of Deepvein
stages.tagline: The mine's deepest gallery collapses into a living throat.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 5:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Ashen Switchback
stages.tagline: Knights, shields and a necromancer hold the switchback road.

stages.name: Gallows Bridge
stages.tagline: A crumbling bridge funnels the dead into a killing ground — for both sides.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 70%

stages.name: Blackwater Sump
stages.tagline: Flooded tunnels spill crawlers and runners from every side.

stages.name: Stormvent Peak
stages.tagline: Whoever holds the sky above the vents holds the peak.

stages.name: Breach of Stonehelm
stages.tagline: The dead throw everything at Stonehelm's outer gate.

stages.name: Cragwatch
stages.tagline: Pikes and slings hold the watchtower crag. Rot hounds run the flanks.

stages.name: Old Bellows Road
stages.tagline: Climbers scale the old bellows road faster than a dwarf can reload.

challenge.text: Win with at most 6 unit types deployed

stages.name: Tallowmere
stages.tagline: Fungal hosts wade the tallow lake; spore moths drift over the water.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 70%

stages.name: Blackpick Galleries
stages.tagline: Axemen and tomb stalkers haunt the blackpick seams. The roof still falls.

stages.name: Belfry of Frostfang
stages.tagline: A dead bell tolls on Frostfang. Every peal raises the fallen.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 6:00 of its arrival

stages.name: The Coal Stair
stages.tagline: Plague soldiers march up the coal stair behind spraying censers.

stages.name: Hammerfall Vale
stages.tagline: Berserkers charge down the vale where the old hammers fell.

stages.name: Rustgate
stages.tagline: A rusted legion and its hexers besiege the iron gate. Catapults lob bone over the wall.

challenge.text: Win with at most 6 unit types deployed

stages.name: Kettle Rock
stages.tagline: Harpies and wraith swarms boil out of the kettle. A flak spire guards them.

stages.name: Grimvent
stages.tagline: Bomb carriers stagger out of the vent with lit fuses. Keep them off the line.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 65%

stages.name: Emberdeep
stages.tagline: Fallen dwarves of Emberdeep march for the dead — and a haunted flying machine with them.

stages.name: Stonehelm Keep
stages.tagline: Rams and mortars batter the keep. The dead brought a walking crypt.

stages.name: The Long Shaft
stages.tagline: Burrowers and grave spiders come up the long shaft from the dark below.

stages.name: Wardens' Ridge
stages.tagline: Wardens, maulers and gargoyles hold the last ridge before the ossuary.

challenge.text: Win with at most 7 unit types deployed

stages.name: Ossuary Hall
stages.tagline: The Matron knits armies from the hall's bones. Break her, then break the citadel.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 7:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Blackbough Verge
stages.tagline: The forest died standing. Something in the grey boughs is breathing for it.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Rotwood Crossing
stages.tagline: Fungal hosts burst into spores when they fall. The hounds come in the fog behind them.

stages.name: Weeping Fens
stages.tagline: The fens weep black water. Anything that stands in it stands still.

stages.name: Sporefall Hollow
stages.tagline: Spore cannons cough rot over the hollow. The moths follow the clouds down.

stages.name: The Gallows Road
stages.tagline: The dead march the old trade road in step, under the gibbets of the living.

challenge.text: Win with at most 7 unit types deployed

stages.name: Carrion Toll
stages.tagline: The toll here is paid in flesh. Vultures collect it; a flak spire keeps the sky theirs.

stages.name: Blightvein Adit
stages.tagline: A copperback came back up the adit with its crew still aboard. They are not dwarves any more.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 70%

stages.name: Mirewatch
stages.tagline: A beacon on the watch-mound feeds the dead. Its cauldron feeds the marsh.

stages.name: Hangman's Thicket
stages.tagline: Ropes still hang from every branch. Some of them twitch.

stages.name: The Rotting Heart
stages.tagline: At the forest's heart a tree has learned to walk. Its roots are full of the dead.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 7:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Ashen Mile
stages.tagline: A ram of fused bones grinds up the ash-grey mile toward your guns.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 65%

stages.name: Sickbed Abbey
stages.tagline: The abbey still tends its sick. Its priests stitch them back into the line.

stages.name: Fungal Deeps
stages.tagline: The lowland seams are furred with spore. The miners grew into the walls.

stages.name: Drowned Wagons
stages.tagline: A supply column sank here. Its flying escort did not stay down.

stages.name: Thornwall
stages.tagline: A wall of thorn and bone. Bolt throwers on the ramparts watch the sky.

stages.name: Rust Cart Ravine
stages.tagline: Rust carts still run the ravine rails, pushed by the dead. So do two copperbacks.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: The Leper Bridge
stages.tagline: One span, no rails, and the lepers' dead still crossing it at a run.

challenge.text: Win with at most 7 unit types deployed

stages.name: Pestwind Downs
stages.tagline: On the downs the plague wind never stops. The harpies ride it in.

stages.name: Ghoul Warren
stages.tagline: The warren's mother calls; her crawling brood answers from every crack.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Court of Pestilence
stages.tagline: The Regent holds court in a palace of censers. The marsh is his carpet.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 8:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Burnt Orchard
stages.tagline: The orchard burned a year ago. The devourers are still eating the harvest.

stages.name: Toll of Crows
stages.tagline: The crows take the toll in eyes. The banshees take the rest.

stages.name: Seeping Gallery
stages.tagline: The gallery floor seeps. Some of what seeps up has teeth.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 65%

stages.name: Blight Lantern Road
stages.tagline: Lanterns of green fire line the road. Every one makes the dead stronger.

stages.name: Stitchyard
stages.tagline: Here the dead sew new dead from old. Two of their works are walking.

stages.name: The Sunken Chapel
stages.tagline: The chapel sank to its bell-tower. Its bell still rings for every dwarf in the water.

stages.name: Wyrmroost Fringe
stages.tagline: Past the fringe the sky belongs to the gravewings. They come down to feed.

stages.name: Cankerworks
stages.tagline: The old cankerworks build again: dead hands, dwarven engines, both turned against you.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Last Ford
stages.tagline: The last ford before the nest. Everything the marsh has left is waiting in the water.

stages.name: Nest of the Matriarch
stages.tagline: Atop the last dead tree sits a nest the size of a keep. Its mother is awake.

stages.name: Windscour Steppe
stages.tagline: The steppe runs flat to the edge of the world. The sky above it is black with wings.

stages.name: Flakline Rise
stages.tagline: Three flak spires stand on the rise like teeth. Nothing flies over them for long.

stages.name: Thermal Fields
stages.tagline: Hot air boils up off the fields in shimmering columns. The fliers know where they are.

stages.name: Shattered Watch
stages.tagline: The old watch-fort fell a century ago. Its new garrison never sleeps, and its turrets burn souls.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Skerry of Bones
stages.tagline: A skerry of rock adrift above the clouds, and a stone road across it. Bone gulls nest on the towers.

stages.name: Gargoyle Parapets
stages.tagline: The parapets have grown statues. When the light goes, the statues come down for you.

challenge.text: Win with at most 8 unit types deployed

stages.name: Stormbreak Ridge
stages.tagline: The ridge splits the storm in two. Lightning finds whatever stands tallest on it, yours or theirs.

stages.name: Drakefall Meadow
stages.tagline: A drake fell here once and burned the meadow black. Now three more circle it, and a barge must cross.

challenge.text: Bring the supply barge safely across

stages.name: The Hanging Keep
stages.tagline: The keep hangs from its island by chains. Its barges come and go full of things that fly.

stages.name: Wyrmcoil Chasm
stages.tagline: The chasm is not a chasm. It is where the wyrm sleeps, coiled through the split rock.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 8:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Banshee Reach
stages.tagline: The banshees hunt along the reach, and a beacon calls the wraiths in after them.

stages.name: Splintered Bastion
stages.tagline: The bastion's walls are splinters. What walks through them now is taller than the walls were.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Cloudmoor
stages.tagline: On the moor of cloud the air falls like water. Fly low here and you fly into the sea.

stages.name: Thunderhead Pass
stages.tagline: Rot launchers wait in the pass under a sky full of thunderheads.

stages.name: Highwatch Citadel
stages.tagline: Highwatch held the plains for six hundred years. Take it back, and the old war foundries open their doors.

stages.name: Serpent's Sky
stages.tagline: Something long and green-lit swims through the clouds under the islands.

stages.name: Ashfall Plains
stages.tagline: Grey ash falls on the plains like snow. It is coming from the howitzers.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Broken Crown Ridge
stages.tagline: On the crown of the ridge a cathedral walks. Its bell strikes and the line stands still.

stages.name: Phantom Armada
stages.tagline: Ghost-lit hulls drift out of the clouds in line abreast. Your supply barge is already underway.

challenge.text: Bring the supply barge safely across

stages.name: The Ghost Fleet
stages.tagline: Moored in the cloud sea, a drowned flagship waits with its guns run out. Its admiral never left the bridge.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 8:30 of its arrival

stages.name: Wyvern Downs
stages.tagline: The downs roll green to the horizon. Wyvern packs hunt them in threes.

stages.name: The Fallen Spire
stages.tagline: The spire fell across the fort. Its beacons still burn, and its turrets still turn.

stages.name: Galeward Heights
stages.tagline: Wind and flak on the heights: the sky is closed until the guns below it fall.

challenge.text: Win with at most 8 unit types deployed

stages.name: Isles Adrift
stages.tagline: Islands drift apart and together. The only ground is a causeway one cart wide.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Dirge Fields
stages.tagline: The bells never stop on the dirge fields. Every toll calls more of the buried up.

stages.name: Gravewing Roost
stages.tagline: Every ledge of the roost is a nest. When one stalker screams, they all do.

stages.name: Rampart of Wings
stages.tagline: Guns on the rampart, wings over it. Neither front can wait for the other.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Stormcrown
stages.tagline: The storm wears the island like a crown. The barge has to cross under it all the same.

challenge.text: Bring the supply barge safely across

stages.name: The Last Clear Sky
stages.tagline: Past the plains the storms begin and do not end. This is the last clear sky; spend it well.

stages.name: Throne of Storms
stages.tagline: A throne of black cloud sits on the storm's eye. The thing on it has been waiting for a dwarven sky.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 10:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Cinderhaven Gates
stages.tagline: The gates of Cinderhaven stand open. Something rolls out of them on dwarven tracks.

stages.name: Rustworks Row
stages.tagline: The assembly line still runs. What it builds now digs.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: The Cold Forge
stages.tagline: The great forge went cold a century ago. Its vents remember how to burn.

challenge.text: Win with at most 8 unit types deployed

stages.name: Boneyard of Engines
stages.tagline: Rusted colossi lie half-buried here. The priests walk among them, singing to the iron.

challenge.text: Let the undead reclaim no wreck

stages.name: Smokestack Alley
stages.tagline: A forest of chimneys, and howitzers nested in it like crows.

stages.name: Assembly Line of the Dead
stages.tagline: Every forty seconds the line clanks forward and another batch of thralls steps off it.

stages.name: Slagrun
stages.tagline: The crucibles cracked when the forge died. The slag still runs when the deep fires stir.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Gravegun Yards
stages.tagline: Row on row of grave-guns, parked where they fell. Not all of them stay parked.

stages.name: Cursed Ironworks
stages.tagline: The ironworks made walkers once. One of them still walks, and it remembers the drill.

stages.name: Titanfall Foundry
stages.tagline: Scaffolding still rings the Titan where it fell. Something has climbed inside and lit the boiler.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 9:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Ashen Boulevard
stages.tagline: Ash drifts down the boulevard like grey snow. The hexers walk in it, and so does fire.

stages.name: Bellows of Hate
stages.tagline: The great bellows burst their pipes. Stand in the steam and your engines drink; stand too long and you cook.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Drillbit Depths
stages.tagline: The floor of the drill hall is not a floor any more. Listen for it.

challenge.text: Win with at most 8 unit types deployed

stages.name: Wreckers' Field
stages.tagline: Every wreck on this field is a gift to the priests. Leave them nothing.

challenge.text: Let the undead reclaim no wreck

stages.name: The Great Smelter
stages.tagline: The Great Smelter poured the iron of a kingdom. Take it back, and the oldest forge-songs can be sung again.

stages.name: Chimney Wood
stages.tagline: Chimneys stand as thick as trees, and something with stone wings roosts in every one.

stages.name: Hall of Pistons
stages.tagline: Pistons the size of towers still hang from the gantries. The rivets are giving way one by one.

stages.name: Iron Ossuary
stages.tagline: A crypt walks between the dead machines, and the dead machines get up behind it.

challenge.text: Let the undead reclaim no wreck

stages.name: Furnace Heart
stages.tagline: At the heart of the forge the vents breathe and the slag runs. Cross between the breaths.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: The Ash Throne
stages.tagline: In the mouth of the great furnace sits a throne of ash. The Tyrant wears the forge like armour.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 9:00 of its arrival

stages.name: Carrier Wharf
stages.tagline: The wharf cranes still swing. The barges they load are full of wings.

stages.name: Rotting Turbines
stages.tagline: The turbine hall hums with flies. The devourers have made it a larder.

stages.name: Colossus Tracks
stages.tagline: The colossi dragged themselves here to die. Their tracks are a road now, and the monsters use it.

stages.name: Molten Stair
stages.tagline: The stair climbs through the crucible hall. Slag comes down it faster than anything goes up.

stages.name: Siegeworks
stages.tagline: The siegeworks built engines for the old kings. The dead have learned to load them with themselves.

stages.name: Plague Refinery
stages.tagline: The refinery brews plague in vats meant for oil. Its priests wait for your engines to fall.

challenge.text: Let the undead reclaim no wreck

stages.name: The Scrapheap Crown
stages.tagline: On top of the great scrapheap the dead have built a crown of dwarven engines, and every one of them runs.

stages.name: Ironfall Avenue
stages.tagline: Gantry bridges span the avenue between the foundry towers. They are coming down, one girder at a time.

challenge.text: Never let the stronghold drop below 60%

stages.name: Forge of Bones
stages.tagline: A forge built of bones, burning in the dark. Everything the dead have learned, they bring here.

stages.name: The Charnel Engine
stages.tagline: A mountain of the dead fills the canyon between the foundry towers, and a siege engine is stitched into its back.

challenge.text: Slay the boss within 10:00 of its arrival
